nom: COSRX Advanced Snail Hydrogel Eye Patch

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: some report burning and redness within minutes, while others describe the patches as gentle, soothing, and free of irritation or breakouts.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report good hydration and no breakouts, with one also noting no issues on acne-prone patches.
segments.mature: A mature-skin reviewer (45) reports good nourishment and tolerates longer-than-recommended wear with no problems.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including one with eczema, report the patches relieve dryness and irritation under the eyes and leave skin hydrated and healthy-looking.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers mention fine lines and say the patches plump, smooth, or diminish their appearance, though most describe this as a hoped-for or minor effect rather than a dramatic change.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report strong, immediate hydration under the eyes, describing skin as plumped, refreshed, and smoother; this is the most consistently praised effect.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the product caused burning and visible redness and advises against use on sensitive skin, while others with sensitive skin report no redness at all.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with eczema and very dry skin reports the patches kept skin hydrated and healthy without worsening her condition.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with a long-standing milia history reports no new bumps after use; another used the patches as spot treatment on acne-prone, dehydrated areas with a calming effect.
concerns.spots: One reviewer hopes the patches help with dark spots but does not confirm a result; another notes the snail line evened out skin complexion generally.

aspects.libelle: Two patch sizes in one jar
Small patches oddly shaped or unusable
Patches slide or slip down face
Texture feels slimy or too slippery

extraits.texte: This product doesn't work for me. I've got a visible skin irritation every time I tried it. I would recommend testing it first. I don't get breakouts easily, and this feels more like a dermatological reaction. There is not much else to say. I have not observed any improvements to the puffiness under eyes.
This product started burning after a couple minutes and left my skin red. I wouldnt use if you have sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: These seem to be very hydrating, and gentle on the sensitive
extraits.texte: These seem to be very hydrating, and gentle on the sensitive skin under my eyes. I haven't noticed any irritation or breakouts. I hope these will help prevent fine lines from forming under my eyes and keep my skin moisturized. The only issue is they do seem to slip down sometimes. But I do my best to adjust them and keep them in place. Skin type: sensitive, combination, acne-prone

extraits.texte: Love them the only issue is the small one are shape funny and don't fit under my eyes therefore 4 stars!!! but the big ones are great. I keep them for longer sometimes then the recommended time and no problem. They nourish the skin very well. I am combination mix skin and "mature" skin (45 yo).

extraits.titre: I've always hated eye masks. Too slippery, they never hold e
extraits.texte: I've always hated eye masks. Too slippery, they never hold enough product, and they're expensive. But these masks are amazing!!! I use both sizes for under my eyes, size doesn't matter. The serum has a little bit of tackiness to it so it stays in place. Plus there's so much product that I don't need any face serum, I just run my fingers over the mask and all the extra serum covers my face!! I love wearing these!! They make my skin feel nourished!! I've had Milia since my teens, and I'm 53 now, and I'm happy to report that these masks haven't caused me any new bumps!! I'm sooooooo into these masks...now and forever!!!:relaxed::yellow_heart:
I have eczema and super dry skin thus is such an affordable option feels very mucb high end love the way it leave my skin so hydrated and healthy looking

extraits.texte: So I bought these based of James Welsh recommendation. I like that it comes with 2 different sizes. I personally didn't use them as eye patches but more so as a spot treatments in my acne prone and super dehydrated areas. I loved them for that super calming and soothing. My one gripe and maybe it's user error, is that they kept slipping and it was a bit hard to get out of the package. But overall great
